presets.label: Club Strobe
presets.description: Fast eighth-note swaps with a hard punch-in for a high-energy club cut.
askedAs: rapid color swaps on the beat

presets.label: Slow Groove
presets.description: Long, relaxed beats with a gentle push and coarse print dots for a laid-back track.
askedAs: gentle pulse on a slow song

presets.label: Clean Poster
presets.description: Smooth flat duotone with no halftone screen, no punch and no indicator for a minimal look.
askedAs: flat two color portrait no dots

presets.label: Waltz Time
presets.description: Three-beat bars at a moderate pace with a medium punch on every downbeat.

presets.label: Gritty Print
presets.description: Very coarse halftone dots with a strong downbeat punch for a raw screen-printed feel.

presets.label: Double Time
presets.description: Doubled playback speed with single-beat bars so every hit lands as a downbeat punch.
